The '''Retro Catalogue''' is a catalogue of furniture and decor items that can be purchased at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Price|110000}}. There is a 10% chance that the catalogue will show up in the shop's inventory.

Once placed, [[File:Right-Click.png|24px]] on the catalogue allows the player to obtain unlimited retro-themed furniture items at no cost. 

'''Tip:''' {{Key|Shift}} + [[File:Left-Click.png|24px]] on an item to add it directly to inventory, instead of attaching it to the mouse cursor.
